source_campaign: CBO | EXCEL | INT | POV and BROLL VIDEO -> видео 1 POV, кадри

banners.prompt:
This input photo is a first-person point-of-view still from a vertical smartphone video: we see through the eyes of a man at his office desk, only his own hands and forearms. Create a NEW still frame for another scene of the SAME video (it will be the starting frame that an AI video model animates; keep the pose simple, hands already in their final position).

CONSISTENCY (critical): the SAME man's hands and forearms (same skin, same hairy forearms, same navy blue shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same black smartwatch on the LEFT wrist), the SAME silver laptop, the SAME desk, desk lamp, paper coffee cup, printed sheets and black backpack, the SAME office. First-person POV, the camera is his eyes. No face, no head, no other people's faces anywhere.
PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, natural light, natural colours, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT cinematic, NOT stock, no HDR.
SCREEN RULE (critical): whenever the laptop screen is visible it is out of focus and soft, only the green-white glow of a spreadsheet grid, NO readable letters, numbers or formulas.
Only two hands with five fingers each. FRAMING: vertical 9:16. The image has plain bars along two edges purely as padding: fill the whole frame naturally, no bars, no borders.
Do not add any captions, labels, logos, watermarks or readable text anywhere, except the digits on the watch when asked and the book cover when a book is shown.

SETTING: the SAME desk and office the next working day in the afternoon: bright natural daylight through the large office windows, the office lights on, colleagues' empty chairs and desks in the background (no faces). Relieved, light mood.
SCENE: EXACTLY the same pose and camera angle as in the input photo: the man raises his LEFT wrist towards his eyes to check the time, the watch face turned towards him exactly like in the input photo, the right hand resting on the desk. The black smartwatch screen is lit and clearly shows '17:00' in large white digits, upright and readable from his point of view exactly like '19:00' in the input photo (exactly '17:00', nothing else on the watch face). Behind the wrist: the silver laptop is CLOSED, and the book lies on the desk next to it, front cover up. The wrist and watch are sharp, the background is slightly soft.
The attached second image is the book. When the book is visible, its FRONT cover must be reproduced exactly and accurately from that image (dark green softcover; large white title 'MS Excel' with 'ЕКСПЕРТ' in bright green below it; an illustration of an open book with glowing green charts, spreadsheets and a green Excel icon; at the bottom in bold white text 'Научи се да работиш с Excel като професионалист, чрез уникалната система EPP'), on a real paperback book with correct perspective. Copy every Cyrillic letter exactly; do not invent or change any letter. The book is closed.
